supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:40 UTC, zoe.adams opened C:\Users\zoe.adams\Downloads\Statement.docm in Microsoft Word. About 11 seconds later, Word spawned PowerShell.
The PowerShell command used -nop, -w hidden, and -enc; decoding the encoded command yields an expression that downloads and executes a script using DownloadString from raw.githubusercontent.com.
The proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunridge-it/tools/main/u.ps1, and network records associate the proxy connection with the PowerShell process.
PowerShell then launched rundll32.exe to invoke Init in C:\Users\zoe.adams\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll.
The recorded PowerShell command specifies a hidden window, so the process records establish PowerShell execution but do not establish why the user briefly saw a window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the script URL and a successful HTTP response, but do not include the downloaded script contents.
The records show rundll32 invoking the DLL entry point, but do not include the DLL contents, hash, signature, or subsequent behavior.
The records do not establish who authored or intentionally initiated the document or command.
